At current fuel spreads, scrubber-fitted Capesizes burning 30 MT/day at sea achieve a daily TCE premium of +,335/day over non-scrubber sister ships. Scrubber-fitted VLCCs burning 40 MT/day capture a +,780/day TCE uplift. Scrubber retrofit CAPEX (~.2m-.6m) payback period is currently 16-18 months at current utilization, explaining the resilient 88%+ secondhand valuation premium for modern scrubber-fitted eco tonnage.

section_title: EU ETS Maritime Carbon Allowance Pricing & Daily Voyage Cost Impact
section_path_text: Bunkers > Environmental Compliance > EU ETS & FuelEU
text: EU ETS carbon allowances trade at EUR 72.50 / MT CO2 (.50/t). Under the phase-in schedule (70% surrender obligation in 2026 scaling to 100% in 2027), maritime carbon compliance cost imposes a significant voyage friction on EU-calling vessels. For an Aframax tanker or Panamax bulker calling NW Europe or Mediterranean ports, daily carbon cost averages ,850-,450/day on 100% intra-EU voyages and -,225/day on 50% incoming/outgoing international voyages (e.g. US Gulf to Rotterdam or Brazil to Dunkirk). Owners increasingly factor EU ETS surcharges into gross freight fixture calculations or charterer clause carveouts.
